edges.reason: The newUpgradeabilityOwner parameter flows directly into the privileged setUpgradeabilityOwner state write.
setUpgradeabilityOwner writes the owner-privileged state variable _upgradeabilityOwner.
upgradeabilityOwner reads the _upgradeabilityOwner state variable.
proxyOwner returns the result of upgradeabilityOwner().
newOwner parameter is used for the zero-address check and ownership event in transferProxyOwnership.
transferProxyOwnership forwards the new owner into setUpgradeabilityOwner, mutating privileged ownership state.
proxyOwner() result is read in transferProxyOwnership for the ProxyOwnershipTransferred event.
Untrusted msg.sender is compared against proxyOwner() inside the onlyProxyOwner modifier.
onlyProxyOwner gates execution of transferProxyOwnership.
onlyProxyOwner gates execution of upgradeTo.
onlyProxyOwner gates execution of upgradeToAndCall.
implementation() reads the _implementation state variable.
_upgradeTo compares against and overwrites the _implementation state variable.
The implementation parameter flows into the _implementation state write inside _upgradeTo.
Proxy.implementation abstract declaration is resolved to the storage implementation accessor.
The fallback function calls implementation() to obtain the delegatecall target.
The fallback assigns the implementation() result to the local variable _impl.
The local variable _impl is used as the delegatecall target address.
The fallback transfer control to the implementation via delegatecall, allowing reentrant execution in proxy context.
The implementation parameter flows into upgradeTo.
upgradeTo invokes the internal _upgradeTo function.
The implementation parameter flows into upgradeToAndCall.
Caller-supplied data is passed to the delegatecall inside upgradeToAndCall, allowing arbitrary external code execution.
upgradeToAndCall first calls upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls caller-controlled data, permitting reentrant execution of external logic.
The owner constructor parameter determines the initial privileged proxy owner.
The constructor calls setUpgradeabilityOwner to install the privileged owner.
The constructor calls _upgradeTo to set the initial implementation.
The initialImplementation constructor parameter is written to the _implementation state variable.
The initialImplementation parameter is the target of the constructor delegatecall.
Constructor calldata is delegatecalled against the initial implementation during deployment.
The constructor delegatecalls arbitrary payload, executing external code in the proxy storage context.
Control of the delegatecalled implementation can re-enter the proxy fallback, enabling reentrancy.
The arbitrary delegatecall invoked by upgradeToAndCall can callback into the proxy during the same transaction.
The constructor delegatecall can re-enter the proxy initialization path before deployment completes.
